content: The process of titrating insulin in both basal and bolus regimens necessitates meticulous monitoring and a thorough understanding of the pharmacodynamic properties of each type of insulin. For example, it is essential to adjust insulin doses based on glucose measurements taken before and after meals. Additionally, periodic evaluations of hemoglobin A1C levels and the frequency of hypoglycemic episodes are critical components of effective management. In certain cases, simplifying or discontinuing complex insulin regimens may be beneficial for patients. This approach can help some individuals, particularly elderly patients, maintain adequate glucose control while also enhancing their overall quality of life.
